observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a stack of 6-7 used tyres standing on bare dirt ground, outdoors.
Tread shows visible wear and surface dirt/mud; no tyre sidewall brand or size text is legible in any photo.
Yellow chalk/paint marks are visible on some sidewalls (used-tyre grading marks), but no readable numbers.
Photo 2 shows four tyres laid flat with alloy wheels partly visible behind them; wheel spoke designs differ, suggesting mixed wheel sets, not necessarily matching the tyres.
No DOT code, size (e.g. 225/45R17), or brand name is readable on any sidewall in any of the 3 photos.
Ground is unpaved dirt yard, consistent with an informal tyre resale lot rather than a shop with inventory tags.
